Agar insan ke irade pakke aur mehnat karne ka jajba hon, to bari se bari vipda ko bhi avsar men badla ja sakta hai. ise sach kar dikhaya hai nalanda ke bihar shariph prakhand kshetr sthit tungi panchayat ke ganjpar ganv ki rahne vali 29 varshiy nitu devi ne.
